forgot.title: Wibagiwe ijambobanga?
forgot.explanation: Andika imeyili yawe y'akazi; tuzohereza kode y'imibare itandatu niba aderesi ifite konti.
forgot.sent: Niba iyo imeyili ifite konti, kode y'imibare itandatu iraje.
forgot.tooMany: Ubusabe bwinshi cyane buva kuri uyu murongo. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'iminota mike.

error.invalidCredentials: Iyi imeyili n'iri jambobanga ntibihuye na konti iyo ari yo yose.
error.locked: Iyi konti yahagaritswe nyuma yo kugerageza kenshi bidatunganye. Koresha umurongo wo kuyifungura woherejwe kuri imeyili yawe.
error.tooManyAttempts: Wagerageje kenshi cyane uhereye kuri uyu murongo. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'iminota mike.
error.unavailable: Kwinjira ntibishoboka ubu. Ongera ugerageze vuba.

pending.title: Gutegereza kwemezwa
pending.explanation: Konti yawe irahari, kandi umuyobozi agomba kuyemeza mbere yuko winjira.
pending.nextStep: Uzabona imeyili igihe yemejwe. Nta muntu ubona amakuru y'uburiganya mbere y'aho.

register.approvalNotice: Umuyobozi yemeza buri konti mbere yo kwinjira.
register.failed: Konti ntiyashoboye gufungurwa. Reba ifishi hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

problem.name: Koresha inyuguti, n'udukoni cyangwa utwatuzo hagati y'ibice.
problem.phone: Iyi nimero ntiyemewe mu gihugu wahisemo.
problem.password: Iri jambobanga ntiryubahiriza amategeko ari hasi.
problem.country: Hitamo igihugu cya nimero ya telefoni.

register.roleNotice: Umuyobozi ni we wemeza inshingano uhabwa.
register.title: Fungura konti

reset.title: Shyiraho ijambobanga rishya
reset.codeExplanation: Andika kode wabonye kuri imeyili, hamwe na aderesi wakoresheje.
reset.codeRefused: Iyo kode si yo, cyangwa yarengeje igihe.
reset.expired: Iyo kode yarengeje igihe. Saba indi.
reset.refused: Ijambobanga ntiryashoboye guhindurwa. Reba amategeko hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

unlock.title: Fungura konti yawe
unlock.unlocked: Konti yawe yafunguwe. Ushobora kongera kwinjira.
unlock.expired: Uyu murongo wo gufungura warengeje igihe cyangwa wamaze gukoreshwa.
unlock.missing: Uyu murongo ubuze kode yo gufungura. Ongera ufungure umurongo wo kuri imeyili.
